fichas.title: Saxony State Theatre, Radebeul — Modernisation and Extension
fichas.summary: Modernisation and extension of a former hotel hall that had accumulated additions and reconstructions over time. The project addressed functional and organisational problems, improved the building’s external appearance, and added a two-storey steel-and-glass foyer. Extensions to storage and wings were constrained by site boundaries and topography. Stage equipment was renewed and slightly extended without complex lifting platforms or turntables, allowing productions to tour to simpler stages. Further extension remains possible.
furniture_equipment: Renewed and slightly extended stage equipment
